Each touched seam changes for exactly one reason: CrewSpec.__post_init__ gains one cohesive new invariant; build_crew_argv/CliBackend gain one cohesive new forwarded flag. No seam absorbs two unrelated concerns.
No new multi-hop attribute chains; spec.reasoning_effort and entry.get('reasoning_effort') are single-hop reads already established by the pre-existing CrewSpec/entry shapes.

The new effort parameter is consumed immediately at both of its two production call sites (CliBackend.dispatch, CliBackend.resume); no unused hook, no abstract base, no configurability added ahead of a second real need.

The new refusal's inline comment and the extended build_crew_argv/build_entry docstrings explain WHY (decision references, the mandatory-vs-optional asymmetry) rather than papering over unclear code; they match this file's pre-existing dense-rationale docstring convention throughout (e.g. the CrewSpec class docstring, the #525 ordering comment already present above the scratch-reservation code).
